Bedroom (in bed)
This bedroom is extremely spare, with dirty laundry scattered haphazardly all 
over the floor. Cleaner clothing can be found in the dresser. A bathroom lies 
to the south, while a door to the east leads to the living room.

On the end table are a telephone, a wallet and some keys.

The phone rings.
